plan.notes: Requirements-only: the official catalog publishes degree requirements but no official semester-by-semester sequence for this program. Transcribed from the standard Biology Track (B.S.). Ranges recorded at minimums: five electives 18-20 hours (recorded 18), capstone 3-4 hours (recorded 3). Natural Science majors may waive up to 9 credit hours of General Education in the NS distribution area. Three Engaged Learning Experiences courses required (one at the 300-level, one Boundary Crossing). Transcribed from the Northeastern Illinois University Academic Catalog 2026-2027 (current online catalog).
